test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 7 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following pairs of authors and autobiographies is CORRECTLY matched?

options.text: Aribam Syam Sharma - Jakhan Choto Chilam

solution:
The correct answer is __**JB Kripalani- My Times**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Acharya Kripalani was born in Hyderabad in Sind in 1888.
 
• He studied in Bombay and Pune and briefly taught at Muzaffarpur College in Bihar and Banaras Hindu University.
 
• Kripalani became the general secretary of the Congress in 1934, a post he held until 1945

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• At the time of independence, in 1947, he was the acting Congress President. 
 
• My Times is a brilliant literary work that will arouse the enthusiasm of scholars of the Indian national struggle, as well as all those who want to glimpse into the world of the freedom-fighters and leaders of the pre-independence.
 
• Kripalani sheds light on the relationship he shared with legendary figures such as Jawaharlal Nehru, Subhas Chandra Bose, Maulana Azad, Sardar Patel, and of course, Mahatma Gandhi.
